statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93229 (prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
Diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I34.0 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
